instructions: Is observed event {source} an immediate input to proposed action {target}? A direct dependency exists if the action directly uses a result, resource, observed condition, or followed instruction from that event. Otherwise no direct dependency exists. Related topics and time order are not dependencies. An upstream event used only through an intermediate event is not a direct input. Judge actual use, not safety.
